description: S457 4a — a bare handler assignment is read WHOLE: `onclick=@count = @count + 1` adds one per click. Before s457 the unquoted-value reader stopped at the whitespace after `@count`, so the handler ran `@count = @count` (the `+ 1` silently dropped, exit 0).
rationale: §5.2 "An unquoted value is read WHOLE" (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S457 "1a 2a 3a 4a 5 dd it 6a", item 4); §5.2.3 table: a bare handler value is one expression — "calls, assignments, compound updates". Two clicks: 0 → 2.
